slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord Jesus, You are the life
And the light of men
The organic life of God in human flesh

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: You were one of a kind
and there was no kind like
You in heaven and earth
Your body was flesh but in spirit truly God

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: You are the Christ, our Lord
The Word of God made flesh
The voice of the Father
That walked in the garden of Eden
The One whom our fathers
and the prophets foretold

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: The heartbeat of our faith
The living breathing Word of God
You are God’s complete
And untouchable Word
And from You life came to light

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Our Lord and King, we give You the glory
Honour and adoration
Lord, You embody the totality of divinity

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Our Lord and King, we give You the glory
Honour and adoration
The great marvel of all ages
Blessing and glory to You forever
The great marvel of all ages
Blessing and glory to You

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: You made us in Your image
and after Your likeness
God’s grace and truth were revealed
to us in You, oh Lord
And by Your resurrection
We’ve been made righteous and holy
Justified by faith in You,
We’ve been made heirs of Your kingdom

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: The life we live is above the systems of the world
A life that’s indestructible and immutable
You have filled our hearts
With peace and joy unspeakable
And now Your love is spread abroad in our hearts
